C9000094.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 094 (Subpolynomial dimension reduction in Lp.; papers: Subpolynomial dimension reduction in Lp; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/094.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_MAIN_DIM_REDUCTION.statement: Manuscript Theorem thm:main: the stated same-exponent subpolynomial dimension upper bound for fixed 1<p<infinity, p!=2, D>1, together with the stated lower and exact-distortion bounds. This theorem remains unaudited as a whole.

C_WEIGHTED_MOMENT.statement: Lemma lem:weighted converts bounded, uniformly weighted approximate moments to the stated embedding dimension, with b and K independent of the test probability.

C_ELECTRICAL_LOCALIZATION.statement: For a finite positive-conductance network, the entrywise absolute value of the symmetric transfer-current projection has spectral norm at most 2 log n. Theorem 1.3 of arXiv:2605.24130v1 states the required weighted version; independent source attribution is pending.

C_WEIGHTED_PROJECTION.statement: Lemma lem:projection: for every strictly positive test probability lambda, choose sigma>=lambda/2 so that the sigma-orthogonal projection onto normalized gradients has infinity norm <=4 log(2n). Fixed-point reweighting is not certified by the source check.

C_HOMOGENEOUS.statement: The manuscript's finite angular homogeneous increments satisfy Pv=v and every marginal has tail a^(-p) and magnitude density p*a^(-p-1) da.

C_BELOW_TWO.statement: The clipped stable-increment construction gives the uniform weighted moment criterion for 1<p<2 with log K=O((log n)^(2-p)). Outside the current mission.

C_RAMP_ESTIMATES.statement: For every real p>2, finite positive edge probability, weighted orthogonal P with infinity norm <=H>=1, and measurable fixed increments with common tail a^(-p), the overlapping ramp has common energy p log 2*(ell^p+2 sum_{j=1}^{ell-1} j^p), weighted error O_p(H^(p-2)*(ell+1)), and relative Lp error O_p(H^(1-2/p)/ell), for every integer ell>=1.

C_RAMP_ENERGY.statement: The dyadic multiplicities are 1,2,...,ell,...,2,1, and their p-energy is exactly p log 2*(ell^p+2 sum_{j=1}^{ell-1} j^p), uniformly in the edge.

C_RAMP_AMPLIFICATION.statement: Signed-dyadic analytic core: for every real p>2 and |a_k|<=B*2^k, |sum a_k|^p <= [4^(p-1)/(1-2^(2-p))]*B^(p-2)*sum 2^((p-2)k)*a_k^2, and the same inequality holds after integration on any measure space. Engineer formal proof compiled; independent review pending.

C_RAMP_APPLICATION.statement: The actual cutoffs A_k=(P-I)v_{<=2^k} obey pointwise caps 2H*2^k and weighted quadratic energies <=p/(p-2)*2^((2-p)k), so the signed-dyadic theorem proves the original ramp error without assuming it.

C_RAMP_SHARPNESS.statement: For the three actual points (0,0),(1,0),(1,1), uniform edge weights, a=2^(1/p), n=(1,1,-a), P=I-n*n^T/(2+a^2), the ramp error energy is exactly 16*ell*log(2)/(3*(2+a^2)^p) for every p>2 and ell>=1. Linear energy growth and reciprocal-ell relative decay are order-sharp; independent review pending.

C_TAPER_FILTER.statement: Every finite dyadic-bin profile c has exact common energy p*log(2)*sum |c_j|^p and projection-error energy <=2^(p-2)*K_p*p/(p-2)*H^(p-2)*||Delta c||_infinity^(p-2)*sum |Delta c|^2. The manuscript ramp is its triangular special case; independent review pending.

C_TAPER_SHARPNESS.statement: The fixed normalized-gradient three-point example has exact error energy 8*log(2)/(3*(2+2^(2/p))^p)*sum |c_j-c_{j-1}|^p for every finite real scale profile c. Every nonzero profile supported on N consecutive bins therefore has relative error >=[8/(3*p*(2+2^(2/p))^p)]^(1/p)/N. This rules out uniform o(1/N) within finite dyadic scale multiplier methods on a class containing this fixed-H example; independent review pending.

C_POISSON_CLIPPING.statement: Nearly additive signed-Poisson moments and the subsequent clipping yield the required uniformly bounded weighted moments for p>2. Outside the current mission.

C_DIMENSION_LOWER_BOUNDS.statement: The packing lower bound, exact upper bound, and exact-distortion quadratic lower bound in thm:main require separate verification. Outside the current mission.
